claim.excerpt: While codeine is not a direct metabolite of DIM, it may appear in postmortem samples following the use of “street heroin,” which often contains 6-acetylcodeine (6-AC), a synthetic byproduct that converts to codeine in vivo.

sources.title: Analytical Methods for the Determination of Diamorphine (Heroin) in Biological Matrices: A Review

why_it_matters: Metabolic pathway statements support interpretation of parent/metabolite findings.
